description: This file implements an eventing system for managing event queues, callbacks, and notifications related to system events such as radio status changes, AP lifecycle, and station events in a wireless system.

methods.name: wld_event_init
methods.description: Initializes all event queues and sets up their pointers and internal lists.

methods.name: wld_event_cleanup_queue
methods.description: Cleans up a specific event queue by removing all subscribers.

methods.name: wld_event_destroy
methods.description: Destroys all event queues, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: wld_event_add_callback
methods.description: Adds a callback to a specified event queue.

methods.name: wld_event_remove_callback
methods.description: Removes a callback from a specified event queue.

methods.name: wld_event_trigger_callback
methods.description: Triggers all callbacks registered in a specified event queue with provided data.
